evals.name: missing-key
evals.prompt: Check this file against the keys title, date, tags: a post whose frontmatter carries title and tags but no date.
evals.expected_output: A table reporting the missing date key with file and line.
assertions: Reports the missing key with its file and line

evals.name: no-frontmatter-block
evals.prompt: Check a file that starts with a heading and has no frontmatter block against the key title.
evals.expected_output: A report naming the file that has no frontmatter block.
assertions: Reports the absent block instead of inventing an empty one

evals.name: all-clean
evals.prompt: Check a file whose frontmatter carries every required key with non-empty values against the keys title, date.
evals.expected_output: A pass report listing the files checked.
assertions: Says every file passes and lists the files checked
